segments.name: Commercial and retail banking
products: deposit and lending products and services
segments.description: Provides deposit and lending products and services to commercial and retail customers, primarily small-to-medium sized businesses, professionals and individuals.
segments.evidence: The Company's primary business is to provide deposit and lending products and services to its commercial and retail customers.

segments.name: Mortgage Banking
products: consumer mortgage loans that will be held-for-investment
segments.description: Originates mortgage loans for sale to investors in the secondary market and consumer mortgage loans held for investment.
segments.evidence: This segment provides mortgage origination services for loans that will be sold to investors in the secondary market and consumer mortgage loans that will be held-for-investment.

segments.name: Investment advisory and non-deposit
segments.description: Provides investment advisory services and sells non-deposit investment and brokerage products to bank customers.
segments.evidence: This segment provides investment advisory services and non-deposit products.

segments.name: Corporate
segments.description: Holds parent company financial information, including interest on parent company debt and dividends received from First Community Bank.
segments.evidence: This segment includes the parent company financial information, including interest on parent company debt and dividend income received from First Community Bank

revenueModel.text: Commercial and retail customers and small-to-medium sized businesses pay interest and fees on deposits, loans, mortgage origination and investment advisory services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Bank is engaged in a general commercial and retail banking business, emphasizing the needs of small-to-medium sized businesses, professionals and individuals.

changes.text: In 2023, consumer mortgage held-for-investment loans were moved into the Mortgage Banking segment from Commercial and Retail Banking.
changes.evidence: In the second quarter of 2023, management made the decision to include consumer mortgage held-for-investment loans in this segment.
